summary: Diagnosis: the Infinigen editable install is present in conda env `infinigen`, but the repository has no native build artifacts at all: `infinigen/terrain/lib` is absent and `infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so` is also missing. The `real_geometry.gin` path sets `compose_indoors.enable_ocmesh_room=True`, which calls `ocmesher_utils.run_ocmesher`; that first loads `terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so`, then would load `OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so`. Recommended official restore command is: `cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen && source /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate infinigen && make terrain`. Expected outputs include `/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so` and `/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so`.
work_completed: Inspected the failing control-tower logs for the real_geometry attempts; both fail at `ctypes.CDLL` loading `/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so`.
Confirmed current generation used conda env `infinigen` from `/home/yashturkar/miniconda3/envs/infinigen` and editable project path `/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen`.
Confirmed no `.so` or `.o` artifacts exist under `/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain` or `/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher`.
Ran read-only syntax/dependency checks for the two directly needed C++ sources: `sdf_from_mesh.cpp` and OcMesher `core.cpp`; both passed with `/usr/bin/g++` 11.4 and `-fopenmp`.

findings.message: The immediate missing library is built by `scripts/install/compile_terrain.sh`: from repo root, `make terrain` compiles `infinigen/terrain/source/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.cpp` to `infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so`.

A second required ocmesher native dependency is also missing: `infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so`. `compile_terrain.sh` enters `infinigen/OcMesher` and runs `source install.sh`, which compiles `ocmesher/source/core.cpp` into that path.

The entire terrain native library tree is absent, not just `sdf_from_mesh.so`. `make terrain` normally builds CPU terrain libs for utils, elements, surfaces, meshing, sdf_from_mesh, and soil_machine; because `/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc` exists, it will also attempt CUDA terrain libs.

The conda env has `infinigen` installed editable, but `infinigen.terrain.marching_cubes._marching_cubes_lewiner_cy` was not found. This is separate from the current ocmesher crash; a full `pip install -e .` build with terrain enabled would build the Cython extension, while `make terrain` only restores the ctypes `.so` libraries.

System prerequisites relevant to the recommended build are present for the direct ocmesher path: conda env `infinigen`, `/usr/bin/g++` 11.4.0, GNU make 4.3, and CUDA nvcc 12.8 at `/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc`.

follow_up_recommendations: Primary command for Experimenter: `cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen && source /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate infinigen && make terrain`.

Optional load verification after build: `conda run -n infinigen python -c "from ctypes import CDLL; CDLL('/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so'); CDLL('/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so'); print('native ocmesher libs load')"`.

If `make terrain` fails in the CUDA section and only official Infinigen-Indoors `real_geometry.gin` needs to be unblocked, build the two direct CPU ocmesher libraries manually: `cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain && mkdir -p lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh && g++ -O3 -c -fpic -fopenmp -o lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.o source/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.cpp && g++ -O3 -shared -fopenmp -o lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.o && cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher && bash install.sh`.

Avoid `make customgt` or `pip install -e '.[terrain,vis]'` as the first recovery action unless OpenGL annotations are required; local GL/GLEW/GLFW/GLM system headers were not present, and they are unrelated to the current ocmesher crash.
memory_worthy: For official Infinigen-Indoors `real_geometry.gin`, the native dependencies needed by `ocmesher_utils.run_ocmesher` are `infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so` and `infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so`; repo-root `make terrain` is the intended local build path.
